description: This file defines the 'CurrentVersionDetailsController' class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrader module. It extends from an abstract controller and manages the pre-render setup for displaying current version details, including setting a Vue component and updating the state container.

classes.name: CurrentVersionDetailsController
classes.description: A controller handling the display of current version details during installation upgrades, sets Vue component and updates current screen state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component for displaying current version details and updates the application state before rendering.
